title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
description: Given the `head` of a linked list represented as an array and an integer `n`, remove the `n-th` node from the end of the list and return its head.

hints.content: Use two pointers separated by n steps.
Advance first pointer n steps ahead, then move both until first hits the end.
Target index from start is list.length - n.

solution.explanation:
Two-pointer sliding window or index calculation to remove node at list.length - n.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
